ctx.text:
Ramayana starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram has been breaking records at the North American box office. It has now outperformed the Chinese blockbuster at the North American box office. The Indian epic has surpassed the lifetime total of the Chinese blockbuster Ne Zha 2 in North America. Keep scrolling for the deets.
The movie is already on track to beat the lifetime total of Dhurandhar 2 at the North American box office, becoming the all-time highest-grossing Indian film ever released in the market. It has strong legs at the North American box office. It also registered the biggest second weekend ever for Indian movies.
According to the latest numbers, Ramayana collected $834k at the box office in North America on its second discounted Tuesday. The movie has declined by 59.4% from last Tuesday at the North American box office, and it has collected over $25.7 million in 12 days. The movie is edging closer to the box office total of Dhurandhar 2, the all-time highest-grossing Indian film ever. It is tracking to earn between $35 million and $40 million in its lifetime in North America.
Ne Zha 2 is a Chinese blockbuster based on the titular mythic figure of Chinese legend and on Xu Zhonglin’s 16th-century novel Investiture of the Gods, the direct sequel to Ne Zha, and was released in 2025. The film collected $23.3 million [via Box Office Mojo ] at the North American box office over its 203-day run. Ramayana has outperformed it at the North American box office in just 12 days.
According to reports, Ramayana is inches away from hitting the $150 million milestone at the worldwide box office. It recently outgrossed Godzilla Minus Zero at the worldwide box office. It is one of the biggest Indian films at the worldwide box office and remains among the trending movies.
The film follows Lord Rama’s journey into exile with Sita and Lakshman, which takes a dramatic turn when Ravana abducts Sita. Determined to rescue his wife, Rama joins forces with Hanuman and the Vanara army to battle the demon king and restore righteousness. Ramayana was released on November 6.
